knowledge.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
Five senses 五种感官动词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: see 看、hear 听、smell 闻、taste 尝、touch 摸，五个动词对应五种感官，是本单元的核心词汇。

knowledge.name: Body parts 感官器官
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: eyes 眼睛、ears 耳朵、nose 鼻子、tongue 舌头、hands 手，注意这些部位表示成对或复数时常用复数形式。
prerequisites: Five senses 五种感官动词

knowledge.name: I can with my 句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: 句型 I can see with my eyes. —— can 后接动词原形，with my + 部位表示「用……」。

knowledge.name: Can you 问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: 问：Can you hear the bird? 肯定答 Yes, I can. 否定答 No, I can't. 问答里的 can 要保持一致。
prerequisites: I can with my 句型

chapters.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?

questions.analysis: hear 是听；see 看、smell 闻、touch 摸，三个都不是「听」。
questions.knowledge_point: Five senses 五种感官动词

questions.stem: 我们用什么器官闻花香？（  ）
questions.analysis: 闻用鼻子，即 nose；ears 听、eyes 看、hands 摸，功能都不对。
看用眼睛，且眼睛是成对的，用复数 eyes；写 eye 语法上也可但与本单元固定表达 eyes 不符。
questions.knowledge_point: I can with my 句型

questions.analysis: taste 对应舌头（tongue），尝出甜、酸、咸等味道，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Five senses 五种感官动词

questions.stem: — Can you smell the soup? — （  ）, I can.
questions.analysis: 答语后半是 I can，说明是肯定回答，用 Yes；No 与 I can 矛盾，Not、Do 不能单独这样用。

questions.stem: — Can you hear me? — No, I （  ）.
questions.analysis: 否定回答是 No, I can't（cannot 的缩写）；写 can not 也可，但不能写 don't，因为问句用的是 can。

questions.stem: 下列单词中，属于身体部位的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A eyes 眼睛 ✓；B ears 耳朵 ✓；C soup 是汤，属于食物 ✗；D hands 手 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: I can see with my ears. 这句话是正确的。
questions.analysis: 看要用眼睛，应为 with my eyes；ears 是耳朵，用于 hear，所以这句话搭配错误。
questions.knowledge_point: I can with my 句型

options: I can taste with my tongue.
I can taste with my eyes.
I can smell with my ears.
I can see with my hands.
questions.analysis: 尝味道用舌头 tongue，A 正确；B 用眼尝、C 用耳闻、D 用手看，器官与动作全部错配。
questions.knowledge_point: I can with my 句型

questions.stem: I can touch the desk with my （  ）.
questions.analysis: 摸用双手，用复数 hands；写 hand 单数不合本单元表达习惯。
questions.knowledge_point: I can with my 句型

questions.stem: 下列句子中，语法正确的有（  ）
options: I can see with my eyes.
I can hears with my ears.
questions.analysis: A can + 动词原形 see ✓；B Can you + 动词原形 hear 疑问句 ✓；C can 后面用了 hears 第三人称单数形式，应为 hear ✗；D She can smell，can 后原形 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: 回答 Can you see the moon? 可以只说 Yes。
questions.analysis: 简答可以说 Yes 或 Yes, I can；两种都符合口语习惯，前者更简短。

questions.stem: 「这朵花闻起来很香」的英文是（  ）
questions.analysis: 花的气味用 smell；sees、hears、touches 分别表示看、听、摸，都不能表达「闻起来香」。
questions.knowledge_point: Five senses 五种感官动词

questions.stem: — What can you do with your nose? — I can （  ）.
questions.analysis: 鼻子对应的动作是闻 smell；答 see 或 hear 都与 nose 不匹配。

questions.stem: 用 I can… with my… 写两句话，分别说明你能用眼睛和耳朵做的事。

answer.value: I can see the blackboard with my eyes. I can hear the teacher with my ears.

questions.analysis: 参考示例：I can see the blackboard with my eyes. I can hear the teacher with my ears. 评分要点：①两句都用 I can…with my…（2 分）；②器官与动作搭配正确（1 分）；③大小写与标点（1 分）。搭配错（如用 eyes 写 hear）不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: I can with my 句型

questions.stem: 看图画描述（用文字）：一个孩子在花园里看花、闻花。请写三句话，至少用上三个感官动词。

answer.value: The boy is in the garden. He can see the flowers with his eyes. He can smell them with his nose, and they smell sweet.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①三句话（1 分）；②至少三个感官动词（see / smell / taste / hear / touch）（2 分）；③句子语法正确、搭配合理（1 分）；④大小写与标点（1 分）。只写单词不成句不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: Five senses 五种感官动词

options: I taste the candy with my tongue.
I taste the candy with my nose.
I hear the candy with my tongue.
I see the candy with my tongue.
questions.analysis: 尝用舌头，A 搭配正确；B 用鼻子尝不对，C 听糖果、D 看糖果都与舌头的功能不符。

questions.stem: 五种感官动词 see、hear、smell、taste、touch 后面都可以直接跟名词。
questions.analysis: 这些动词都是及物动词，后面可以直接接宾语，如 see the bird、touch the desk。
questions.knowledge_point: Five senses 五种感官动词

questions.stem: — Can you （  ） the flower? — Yes, it smells sweet.
questions.analysis: 答语说它闻起来香，所以问的是能不能闻，用 smell；填 see 则答语应说 it looks…。
